result.ca_name_from_pdf: Swedish Social Insurance Agency (SSIA) Certification Authority
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.7
qualifications: We draw attention to SSIA management's statement disclosure regarding SC47v2 ("Sunset subject:organizationalUnitName) in "Management's Statements – WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security", which describes the conditions regarding prohibited use of organizationalUnitName. We recognize that this has been a violation of the baseline requirements during the audit period, however, given the context of the violation and the fact that SSIA management has informed relevant providers of root stores and removed the attribute on 19 March 2024, our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

disclosed_matters.summary: SSIA overlooked CA/Browser Forum ballot SC47v2 when published in 2021, which prohibited issuance of new certificates with organizationalUnitName attribute on or after 1 September 2022; the attribute was removed on 19 March 2024.
